description:
Riot’s Anti-Cheat team is versatile and passionate about its craft. We understand the player impact of cheating in games and are focused on setting the highest bar for the integrity of multiplayer games. At the most fundamental level, our goal is to promote the best player experience by protecting the legitimacy of their favorite games.

As a Manager, Anti-Cheat Engineering, you will lead the team responsible for the ongoing development and evolution of Vanguard Anti-Cheat’s Windows client services. You’ll set technical direction, shape priorities, and ensure the team delivers secure, reliable capabilities across Vanguard’s Anti-Cheat suite in a timely manner. While your primary focus will be enabling the team and driving outcomes, your strong fluency in cheat communities and techniques will allow you to guide architecture, challenge technical decisions, and step directly into complex debugging or investigations when needed.   • Manage, identify, recruit, interview, and hire engineers to help the team scale effectively

  • Lead the team in rapidly translating emerging threats into resilient detections and preventative countermeasures that can be safely deployed at scale
  • Balance immediate threat response with proactive technical investments that anticipate adversaries’ next moves or eliminate common abuse vectors entirely
  • Guide and participate in complex investigations involving highly evasive cheats and operating-system manipulation techniques
  • Ensure the team can diagnose and resolve complex compatibility, reliability, and security issues in highly opaque environments, stepping into the details when needed
  • Build trusted relationships with game teams as internal customers, helping them understand their cheating ecosystems, integrate Anti-Cheat effectively, and make informed tradeoffs across security, player experience, scope, and delivery
  • Establish clear priorities and technical expectations, helping engineers navigate uncertainty and make sound decisions across security, compatibility, performance, and operational risk
  • Partner across engineering, product, operations, and game teams to align dependencies, communicate risk, and deliver anti-cheat capabilities successfully across Riot’s portfolio

  • Familiarity with cheat-development or game-security research communities and a practical understanding of modern cheat techniques and anti-cheat evasions
  • Strong understanding of Anti-Cheat architectures, with the ability to evaluate designs, guide technical discussions, and engage directly when complex problems require it

description:
As a Revenue Accounting Manager, you’ll be in charge of certain areas of the game revenue accounting at Riot Games.  This involves critical accounting player life estimates, big data transaction reconciliation and automation for micropayments, devising structure to address controls and risks including for accounts receivable, and thoughtfully developing the technical accounting for emerging revenue issues.  To be successful, you’ll need to be flexible working at both a review level and a hands-on detailed level.  You will drive projects forward and collaborate with other teams including Finance, Game teams, Payments, Legal, Data, and accounting teams in our global offices.

Responsibilities:

  • Reconcile large sales datasets with engineering team across the order to cash process.  This data would include information from international payment processors with unique fees, FX, and taxes.

  • Research and formalize technical accounting including Principal vs Agent, Point in Time vs Over Time, Costs to obtain a contract, and Consideration payable to a customer.  
  • Review draft contracts to ensure smooth technical accounting.
  • Build out approaches and systems to address key risks such as receivables collectability and chargebacks monitoring.
  • Project manage and oversee certain day to day, period end close, and audit related activities
  • Implement improved approaches to internal revenue data and systems.  This may include implementing a more sophisticated revenue system and the related processes
  • Mentor team staff
  • Manage relationships with external auditors to ensure timely completion of annual audits and reviews

Required Qualifications: 

  • A bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance. Big 4 experience and a CPA designation is required.

  • Project manage key areas with multiple groups.  Organize and prioritize effectively and meet deadlines while maintaining quality.
  • Analytical, interested in deeply understanding areas, consider why an approach is better than 1-2 alternatives. 
  • Some statistical experience, ideally in relation to critical accounting estimates.
  • Strong understanding of revenue recognition in a technology/entertainment company
  • Comfortable working with big data processes and engineer / analysts for high volume revenue transactions.
  • Strong leader in training and developing high-performing individuals with a clear commitment to the development and engagement of the team.  Effectively listen and demonstrate an effective, collaborative approach.

Desired Qualifications:

title: Senior Anti-Cheat Engineer - Central Technology, Anti-Cheat
description:
Riot Anti-Cheat Engineers are versatile and passionate about their craft. We understand the player impact of cheating in games and are focused on setting the highest bar for the integrity of multiplayer games. At the most fundamental level, our goal is to promote the best player experience by protecting the legitimacy of their favorite games.

As a Senior Anti-Cheat Engineer, you will be responsible for the ongoing development and evolution of Vanguard Anti-Cheat’s client services. With versatility across user-mode, kernel-mode, and obfuscation tooling services, you’ll work primarily in C/C++ and x86/x64 assembly to build new anti-cheat features, improve the security and reliability of existing systems, and debug complex behavior across the Windows stack. You’ll also reverse engineer emerging cheats, including packed and obfuscated binaries, and rapidly translate those findings into practical detections, mitigations, and preventative controls. You'll be based in our Santa Monica, CA office and work in a hybrid (work-from-home and in-office) environment. You'll report to the Sr. Manager of Anti-Cheat Engineering.

Responsibilities:

  • Identify and drive high impact anti-cheat features from ambiguity to production across user-mode, kernel-mode, and obfuscation tooling surfaces
  • Move fast to turn emerging threats into resilient detections or preventative countermeasures that can be safely deployed with agility at scale.
  • Think ahead to design and develop capabilities that anticipate the cheaters next move or eliminate common abuse vectors entirely
  • Reverse engineer highly evasive cheats and operating system manipulation techniques
  • Investigate and resolve complex compatibility issues in highly opaque environments
  • Support game teams directly in understanding cheating ecosystems and integrating Anti-Cheat

  • Hands-on reverse engineering experience, including analyzing packed, protected, or obfuscated binaries and identifying techniques used to conceal or manipulate runtime behavior
  • Practical understanding of the Windows kernel and driver model, with demonstrated experience developing, debugging, and maintaining production grade kernel-mode drivers.

description:
Riot’s Enterprise Technology organization ensures Rioters have what they need to unlock their full potential, from secure and compliant systems to efficient business platforms that keep the company running smoothly. description:

Embedded with Riot’s Growth Marketing team, you will partner closely with Growth leads across Riot’s portfolio to translate each game’s strategic objectives into high-performing creative, applying proven performance practices while ensuring the work authentically reflects the game and its community.
